9.content: “I thought of a labyrinth of labyrinths, of one sinuous spreading labyrinth that would encompass the past and the future and in some way involve the stars.” ― Jorge Luis Borges, The Garden of Forking Paths . These pages contain notes, discussions, and references on various topics I think about beyond physics—mostly books music and films. <!--
